6 major themes

Themes

Explore the big questions shaping the future of geospatial.

🗂️

Data & Territories

Governance, openness and value of geospatial data in the service of the territory.

🏙️

Smart Cities

How geospatial is transforming urban management and citizen services.

🌿

Environment & Climate

Mapping climate change, monitoring ecosystems and environmental geomatics.

🚀

Geospatial Innovation

New technologies, sensors, drones, LiDAR and emerging platforms.

🤖

AI & Geospatial

Artificial intelligence, machine learning and predictive territorial analysis.

🤝

Civic Participation

Participatory mapping, democratization of tools and community engagement.
